description: This PHP class, Workbook, is responsible for writing a Spreadsheet object to the XLSX XML format. It includes methods for writing various parts of the workbook such as file version, properties, views, protection, calculation settings, sheets, and associated XML structures.

classes.name: Workbook
classes.description: A class responsible for writing a Spreadsheet object to an XLSX file format, including various internal methods to write different components of the workbook XML structure.

methods.name: writeWorkbook
methods.description: Main method to generate the XML output of the entire workbook, including various subcomponents like sheets, properties, protections, and calculation settings.

methods.name: writeFileVersion
methods.description: Writes the fileVersion XML element with specific attributes about the application name, last edited version, and build.

methods.name: writeWorkbookPr
methods.description: Writes the workbookPr XML element, including the date1904 attribute based on the calendar setting.

methods.name: writeBookViews
methods.description: Writes the bookViews section, including the active sheet, view options, and sheet visibility settings.

methods.name: writeWorkbookProtection
methods.description: Writes protection flags and passwords for the workbook if security is enabled.

methods.name: writeCalcPr
methods.description: Writes calculation properties, including calcId, calcMode, and whether recalculation is needed on load.

methods.name: writeSheets
methods.description: Iterates over all sheets in the Spreadsheet to write individual sheet XML elements.

methods.name: writeSheet
methods.description: Writes an individual sheet element with attributes such as name, id, state, and relationship ID.
